notes: FROZEN before any model score exists. Descriptions are one-sentence scene lines. searchQuery is a short keyword query (<=100 chars). visualTarget and acceptableProxies are fixed in advance: a candidate may not be retro-fitted to a scene. split is derived by the stratified SHA-256 rule in PREREGISTRATION.md and re-verified by the tooling.
candidatePickRule: One Pixabay search per scene (image_type=photo, safesearch=true, per_page=20, default order). Eight candidates at evenly spaced 0-based positions floor(i*n/8), i=0..7 (0,2,5,7,10,12,15,17 when n=20). Fixed in advance; does not use SigLIP.
